body:
Three founder-proposed primitives built and tested: io/mmap.prn (zero-copy mmap, String-typed live-mapped bytes), pentest/procmaps.prn (real /proc/[pid]/maps parser, honest I32 boundary on 64-bit fields), set.prn (real FNV-1a open-addressing StringSet, intersect/union/difference). Found+fixed 2 real compiler gaps and 1 runtime SIGSEGV along the way. make test: 348/348. Commit 050fe0b.

⚓ ☃
title: Real mmap, /proc/maps parser, and hash-set primitives (io/mmap, pentest/procmaps, set)
